# CompTIA

> > CompTIA provides vendor-neutral IT certifications including A+, Network+, and Security+ for cybersecurity, networking, and IT support professionals.

CompTIA (Computing Technology Industry Association) offers industry-standard certifications that validate technical skills across IT infrastructure, cybersecurity, and support roles. The organization also maintains the CompTIA Instructor Network (CIN) for certification trainers and educators, and provides resources aligned with DoD 8140 requirements for government IT positions.

## Key Topics

- CompTIA A+ Certification
- CompTIA Security+ (SY0-701)
- CompTIA Network+ (N10-009)
- A+ Core 1 and Core 2
- DoD 8140 Compliance
- IT Certification Exams
- Cybersecurity Certification
- CompTIA Instructor Network (CIN)
- Public Key Infrastructure (PKI)
- IT Security Fundamentals
- Network Infrastructure
- Certification Training
- Entry-Level IT Support
- Exam Objectives
- Professional IT Networking

## Core IT Certifications

- [A+ Certification | CompTIA](https://www.comptia.org/en-us/certifications/a/): CompTIA A+ certification overview for entry-level IT support careers
- [A+ Core 1 Certification V15 (New Version) | CompTIA](https://www.comptia.org/en-us/certifications/a/core-1-v15/): A+ Core 1 V15 certification for IT support and technical roles
- [Security+ (Plus) Certification | CompTIA](https://www.comptia.org/en-us/certifications/security/): Security+ (SY0-701) certification for IT security and cybersecurity careers
- [Network+ (Plus) Certification | CompTIA](https://www.comptia.org/en-us/certifications/network/): Network+ (N10-009) certification for network infrastructure skills

## Instructor Resources

- [CompTIA Instructors Network](https://cin.comptia.org/): CompTIA Instructor Network (CIN) community for certification training

## Learning Resources & Blog

- [What Is Information Technology? | CompTIA Blog](https://www.comptia.org/en-us/blog/what-is-information-technology/): Overview of information technology careers and types from CompTIA
